name: Robe of Spellwarding
body:
Price 40,000 gp; Aura strong abjuration; CL 17; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This shimmering silk robe is stitched with arcane runes and is coated in a powder of precious stones adhered to the silk. This robe grants the wearer a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws. Additionally, it functions as a ring of counterspells, except is can hold, and counter, a single spell of any level.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 20,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells imbue with spell ability, resistance
